Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

The Finance Systems team is seeking an experienced Netsuite Systems Manager with strong functional and IT support experience to join the team. In this individual contributor role you will be responsible for administration, configuration, and support for our Netsuite ERP system and associated Finance Business Systems. Additionally, you will be a Finance Systems thought leader and champion of best IT/functional practices, IT General controls, and process improvement automation. Reporting directly to Sr Director of Finance Systems, you will collaborate closely with Business Application, Sales Operations, IT, and our Finance team. This position is 100% remote.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Netsuite System Administration

  • Own day-to-day operations of NetSuite, and other Finance Business systems including hands on user support and troubleshooting.
  • Administer and support the NetSuite ERP system, focusing on Financial, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), and Zone billing module
  • Perform system configuration, customization, upgrade and maintenance along with compliance in change management, ITGC, and SDLC processes.
  • Develop and maintain workflows, custom fields, and scripts.
  • Manage NetSuite integrations with other business systems.
  • Oversee user access management, SOD Reviews, and annual/quarterly review process to resolve segregation of duties conflicts.
  • Oversee the governance, change management, end to end maintenance including general ledger accounts, cost centers, products, and any other necessary structures to support the reporting needs of key stakeholders. Manage ticketing system for tracking open cases/change request to resolution
  • Optimize system settings, workflows, and customizations for maximum efficiency.
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with SOX regulations.
  • Provide training and support to end-users.

Program Management

  • Manage/Configure finance transformation projects focusing primarily on the order to cash cycle, encompassing Lead/Opportunity, Contract Management, Quoting/CPQ, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Billing, Credit, Collections/Disputes, and Cash Application processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Legal,Engineering, Finance and IT to gather requirements and implement solutions that enhance business processes.
  • Identify, scope, and prioritize projects based on business needs. Develop detailed project plans, including approach, timelines, milestones, and resources, ensuring on-time and within-budget project delivery.
  • Define data-driven frameworks and processes to identify, measure, and manage program success, focusing on business value, including benchmarking.
  • Ensure procedures, processes, and proper change controls are followed on all production changes and implementation projects
  • Work with sales operations and biz app teams on system enhancements.

Dashboard Creation and Reporting

  • Utilize NetSuite's native tools and our very own Grafana dashboard to create high-performing dashboards tailored to Finance needs.
  • Develop reports and visualizations to provide actionable insights from finance data.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in computer Science, information technology, accounting, finance or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience with as a Finance System Administrator with Netsuite and financial systems tools such as Zip, Avalara, Expensify etc
  • Hands-on IT support experience, including troubleshooting and resolving functional & technical issues.
  • Experience with data migration, data mapping, and data integration within Netsuite including the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module including Zone and Company billing module,and Salesforce integration.
  • Administrator-level knowledge of privileged access, content groups, multiple charts of accounts, dynamic approval chains, custom objects, tax codes, tolerances, custom workflows, supplier configuration, and report building
  • Knowledge of ITGCs and experience working in SOC, ISO, and SOX compliant environments
  • Demonstrated experience integrating accounting systems with Salesforce / SFDC, ideally including CPQ and experienced level with Netsuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)
  • Experience with project management concepts and tools such as Github, Monday.com and Miro.
  • Sharp analytical skills coupled with the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues with ease
  • Knowledge of core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, record to report.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work in a rapidly changing global and remote environment
  • You work well in both a team environment and independently
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to speak cross-functionally

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is $144,000 - $173,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Req ID:395082

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer to join our team in Herndon (REMOTE), Virginia (US-VA), United States (US).

Job Summary:

The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining advanced cybersecurity and identity and access management (IAM) solutions across all client environments, including cloud, IoT, edge, and data systems. This role is critical to ensuring that client meets and sustains compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management requirements, including RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP controls. The engineer leads the design and enforcement of secure authentication, authorization, and RBAC frameworks, supporting multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and integration with providers. The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer works closely with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices into all phases of the system lifecycle, including secure configuration baselines, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response. The position requires hands-on experience with IAM platforms, PKI, secure directory services, and the implementation of audit logging and compliance reporting. The engineer maintains comprehensive documentation, supports audit and ATO processes, and ensures that all client solutions are resilient, auditable, and optimized for operational readiness and regulatory compliance.

Job Duties:

  • Architect, implement, and maintain advanced IAM solutions, including RBAC, MFA, SSO, and integration with providers
  • Develop and enforce secure authentication and authorization frameworks for client's cloud, edge, and data environments
  • Lead the implementation of secure directory services, PKI, and certificate management for all client components
  • Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response in compliance with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP requirements
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices throughout the system lifecycle
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for IAM architectures, security controls, and compliance artifacts
  • Support audit, ATO, and risk management processes, including evidence collection and remediation of findings
  • Implement and monitor audit logging, access reviews, and compliance reporting for all client environments
  • Provide technical support for user provisioning, deprovisioning, and lifecycle management
  • Participate in security assessments, code reviews, and compliance audits as required by contract and SOW

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering, or Mathematics with a concentration in computer science or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience with cybersecurity engineering
  • Must be US Citizen with ability to obtain a Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and managing IAM solutions in regulated or mission-critical DoD environments
  • Proficiency with RBAC, SSO, MFA, PKI, and secure directory services
  • Experience with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP cybersecurity and compliance requirements
  • Familiarity with AWS GovCloud, cloud security, and secure integration of edge/IoT devices
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to produce compliance artifacts and technical guides
  • Experience supporting audit, ATO, and risk management processes for federal systems
  • Information Assurance Management (IAM) or Information Assurance Technical (IAT) or Information Assurance System Architect and Engineer (IASAE) Level I (position-based) per DoD 8570.1M

At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

Build products customers value. Turn insights into action. Drive ideas from opportunity to impact.

At PDI Technologies, we build technology that helps businesses operate more efficiently, make smarter decisions, and deliver better experiences for their customers. We’re looking for a Product Manager who is curious, customer-focused, and energized by turning real-world problems into meaningful product solutions.

In this role, you’ll own a product or key product area, working closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring solutions to market.

This is a great opportunity for a Product Manager who has built a solid foundation in product management and is ready to take greater ownership of product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business outcomes.

What you'll do

    • Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for an assigned product or product area.

    • Develop a deep understanding of customers, users, business needs, and market trends.

    • Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and outcomes.

    • Partner closely with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, development, testing, launch, and iteration.

    • Prioritize features and initiatives by balancing customer value, business impact, technical considerations, effort, and risk.

    • Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and other stakeholders.

    • Use product analytics, customer insights, and market data to evaluate performance and guide decisions.

    • Define success measures and monitor product adoption, utilization, customer experience, and business impact.

    • Partner with go-to-market teams to support product launches, positioning, enablement, and adoption.

    • Communicate roadmap priorities, product decisions, progress, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.

    • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve the product and customer experience.

    • Use AI-enabled tools to improve product discovery, research, requirements development, analysis, and day-to-day product management.

    • Continuously learn, test assumptions, and adjust priorities based on results.

What we're looking for

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

    • 3–5+ years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or related technology experience, with direct product management experience preferred.

    • Experience working with software or technology products through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.

    • Working knowledge of Agile product development practices and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

    • Experience developing product requirements, user stories, roadmaps, and prioritization recommendations.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data and customer insights into product decisions.

    • Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with Engineering teams.

    • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between technical, customer, and business audiences.

    • Experience collaborating across Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, or similar functions.

    • Comfort working through ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and making informed trade-offs.

    • Customer-focused mindset with genuine curiosity about how people use products and where their biggest challenges lie.

    • Experience with product and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or similar platforms.

    • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SaaS, cloud-based, enterprise software, payments, retail technology, data, or platform products.

    • Experience conducting customer discovery, competitive analysis, or market research.

    • Experience using product analytics to measure adoption and inform roadmap decisions.

    • Exposure to APIs, integrations, data platforms, or other technical product concepts.

    • Experience participating in product launches and go-to-market activities

What Success looks like

    You’ll be successful in this role when you understand the customer problem behind the request, not just the requested feature. You’ll bring clarity to competing priorities, build strong partnerships across teams, use data and customer insight to make thoughtful decisions, and consistently move products from idea to measurable customer and business value.

As an intern with the Rail Public Projects team, you will assist with the coordination of public projects on behalf of our railroad clients which includes project management services, coordination with various government agency project sponsors, progressing project assignments from cradle-to-grave, and providing timely reporting and communication to our rail clients and agencies.   • Ensure compliance with Amazon's advertising policies and guidelines, staying informed about any changes or updates in the platform.

  • In-depth knowledge of Amazon PPC campaign management, including campaign types, targeting options, bid management, and keyword optimization.

  • Expertise in using the Amazon Advertising platform, analytics tools, and data analysis techniques to measure and improve campaign performance.

Summary

HII Mission Technologies is seeking a Business Operations Manager to provide remote operational, administrative, and financial support to the STINGRAI program. The Business Operations Manager will provide comprehensive administrative, operational, and financial support to the STINGRAI Program Manager and cross-functional teams. This role manages day‑to‑day business processes, coordinates project and resource activities, oversees financial reporting and subcontractor management, and serves as a key liaison with internal departments including accounting, legal, HR, and the Program Support Office (PSO). Steadfast Health was founded to establish a new standard of substance use disorder (SUD) care. Recognizing that traditional treatment methods often fall short of reaching patients when they’re most in need, Steadfast is relentlessly focused on making low-barrier, high quality care accessible to all. We know that the journey to recovery is unique for every individual, and our patient-centered approach ensures we meet patients where they are, providing evidence-based therapies with unwavering support in a compassionate environment that fosters healing and growth.

Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour per week, fully remote, W2 position. The schedule includes required evening coverage Monday through Thursday, 5:00–8:00 PM ET, with the remainder of the 25 hours worked during daytime business hours of Monday-Friday 9a-5p.

What a Role at Steadfast Gives You

  • Predictable income, every pay period: a fixed base salary plus a monthly performance incentive, not variable, per-session pay that swings with cancellations, no-shows, or slow weeks.
  • Protected non-billable time, built into your schedule: 10.5 hours per week of paid,protected time for documentation, supervision, case consultation, and lunch — all part of your paid day, not unpaid work you fit in around billable hours.
  • Manageable, capped caseloads: we cap caseload size to protect quality of care and your wellbeing, growth in your caseload is planned and supported, not something you're expected to sustain indefinitely to keep your income up.
  • Administrative burden handled for you: in-house billing, AI-assisted documentation support, and MA/LPN and Peer Recovery Specialist support mean your time goes to patients, not paperwork or chasing reimbursement.
  • Full benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) match, paid time off, and 100% employer-paid disability and life insurance

Why Steadfast

  • Healthcare Coverage: medical, dental & vision insurance, plus 100% employer-paid short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
  • 401(k) Match: up to 5% company match.
  • Time Off: 29 days off a year to start (PTO, floating holidays, paid volunteer days), increasing on your anniversary — plus 4 Re-Fuel Days annually for mental health, rest, or CEU activities.
  • Continuing Education: annual CEU stipend and ongoing paid training.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): free, confidential access to therapy, legal, financial, and wellness resources.
  • Protected Time: built into your day for recharging, clinical supervision, huddles, care planning, and admin work.
  • Clinical Support: MA/LPN and Peer Recovery Specialist support, a collaborative care model with physician backup, and manageable panel sizes.
  • Additional perks: SoFi student loan interest rate discount, Rightway Health Concierge, a year of free pet telehealth through Pawp, and Perkspot discount marketplace.
  • Soulside AI documentation support: because your energy belongs with patients, not paperwork.

We believe lived experience with recovery is a strength, not a barrier — many of our team bring personal or family experience with addiction and recovery, and we welcome candidates in recovery to apply. This is also a ground-floor opportunity to help shape how we grow in the Raleigh market.

Key Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide individual and group therapy sessions for patients with substance use disorders, via telehealth, embodying the Steadfast patient-first ethos.
  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments and develop individualized treatment plans, modeling a non-paternalistic and destigmatizing approach to patient care.
  • Utilize evidence-based therapeutic modalities, such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), to support patient recovery.
  • Collaborate with all clinic-level team members to formulate and execute patient care plans, including Advanced Practice Providers, Medical Assistants, and Peer Recovery Specialists, ensuring integrated treatment approaches.
  • Support patients in crisis intervention situations and coordinate higher levels of care when necessary.
  • Maintain thorough and timely documentation in compliance with state, federal, and organizational guidelines.
  • Pioneer innovative ways of improving access and overall care for disadvantaged, marginalized populations.
  • Champion the company’s mission by modeling compassion and fostering trust and strong relationships with patients and communities.
  • Educate patients and families on SUD, co-occurring disorders, and available resources to support sustained recovery and overall health.
  • Participate in regular case consultations, team meetings, and continuing education to stay current with best practices in SUD treatment.

Qualifications

  • Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)or LISW, IMFT in Ohio.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience providing therapy to individuals with substance use disorders.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience providing therapy in an IOP, PHP, or comparable treatment setting.
  • Certification in addiction counseling is a plus.
  • Experience with telehealth platforms and virtual care delivery is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of SUD diagnoses, medications, and treatment modalities.
  • Ability to effectively interact with diverse staff, patients, and community members.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, a flexible, can-do mentality, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Passionate about Steadfast Health’s mission to provide low-barrier, non-punitive, harm-reductionist SUD care.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods during patient sessions and team meetings.
  • Frequent use of hands for typing, writing, and handling clinical documentation.
  • Ability to quickly respond to emergencies, including assisting patients in distress or crisis situations.
  • Visual and auditory acuity to assess patient needs, read documentation, and communicate effectively.
  • Potential exposure to high-stress situations requiring emotional resilience and de-escalation skills.

Investors & Partners

Steadfast Health is proudly funded by Google Ventures (GV) and launched out of Triple Aim Partners. Since 2019, Triple Aim Partners (TAP) has partnered with entrepreneurs across the healthcare ecosystem to build transformative organizations, all with the mission of achieving the Triple Aim (better patient experience, better population health, and lower healthcare costs for all). TAP emphasizes the importance of creating strong, front-line focused company cultures that enable high-quality patient care.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.


This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.


You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.
  • Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.
  • Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.
  • Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.
  • Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.
  • Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.
  • Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.
  • Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

What you’ll need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.
  • Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.
  • Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.
  • A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.
  • Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.
  • Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers
  • Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-abuse-research-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-abuse-research-engineer</a></p>

<div><strong>Job description</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>We are seeking a highly skilled <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to join our team and contribute to the transformative tech evolution in healthcare.&nbsp;</li>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6508/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>

    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://humaneworld.org">https://humaneworld.org</a>
</p>

<p><em>The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education.</em></p>
<p><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance;</li>
<li>Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment;</li>
<li>Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners;</li>
<li>Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance;</li>
<li>Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms;</li>
<li>Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports;</li>
<li>Performs other duties as assigned.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications and Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required;&nbsp;</li>
<li>A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required;</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs;</li>
<li>Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs;</li>
<li>Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot;</li>
<li>Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance;</li>
<li>Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings;</li>
<li>Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement;</li>
<li>Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma;</li>
<li>Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences;</li>
<li>Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology;</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills;</li>
<li>Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus;</li>
<li>Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics;</li>
<li>Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment;</li>
<li>Interest in animal protection issues preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>This is a full-time remote position based in the United States.&nbsp;Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed.&nbsp;</strong></p>

<p>Q<em>ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status.&nbsp; EOE</em>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Doximity: Commercial Data Scientist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Legal Ops</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC or Remote (EST or CST)
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Risk Associate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale.</p>
<p>This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners.</p>
<p>This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions.</li>
<li>Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change.</li>
<li>Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking.</li>
<li>Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials.</li>
<li>Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you.</li>
<li>Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible.</li>
<li>Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums.</li>
<li>Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment.</li>
<li>Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting.</li>
<li>Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating.</li>
<li>A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.</li>
<li>Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask.</li>
<li>Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators</li>
<li>Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate</li>
<li>Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner.</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is <span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-3d77e89a-8e74-80c6-adbd-001cb1e28a1e notion-enable-hover">$86,000 - $144,000,</span> plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO</li>
<li>12-weeks fully paid parental leave</li>
<li>4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)</li>
<li>Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year</li>
<li>3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary <a href="http://Privacy.com">Privacy.com</a> employee account</li>
<li>Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match</li>
<li>401(k) match</li>
<li>Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD</li>
</ul>
<p>NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.</p>
<p>In-office employees receive:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Commuter benefit</li>
<li>Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday</li>
</ul></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate</a></p>

      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai</a></p>
</description>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. <p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.</li>
<li>Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).</li>
<li>Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.</li>
<li>Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.</li>
<li>Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.</li>
<li>High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.</li>
<li>Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.</li>
<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Our Tech Stack</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels.
